nameOfQualification: Jal Vitaran Sanchaalak (Water Distribution Operator) (Multi - Skill)
description: Jal Vitaran Sanchaalak (Water Distribution Operator) would act as a one stop solution provider who gives various services to communities under the Jal Jeevan Mission scheme such as plumbing installation, maintenance, repair and operations of various plumbing related structures and systems. The person will also mobilize community members and organize for required resources across a specified geographic area with support from Village Water and Sanitation Committee, Gram Panchayat and government bodies. The person carries operations on basic masonry work along with basic electrical installation.
awardingBodyName: WATER MANAGEMENT AND PLUMBING SKILL COUNCIL
typeOfQualification: Multi skill (MS), Upskilling, For ToT, For ToA
